# Read-only; managed by tacctl.
# Credentials: this scope's own (tacctl scope snmp lab show --reveal).
# Allowed clients: the tacctl server first, the scope's ranges, then everything else (0.0.0.0/0) refused.
# The tacctl server's address could not be detected: add its /32 first by hand, or pass --source <address>.
# set snmp client-list TACCTL-SNMP <tacctl-server-address>/32   (its address is not known)
set snmp client-list TACCTL-SNMP 198.51.100.0/24
set snmp client-list TACCTL-SNMP 0.0.0.0/0 restrict
set snmp community lab-ro-community authorization read-only
set snmp community lab-ro-community client-list-name TACCTL-SNMP
set snmp location "Rack 4, DC1"
set snmp contact "NOC <noc@example.net>"
set snmp description "Core switch"
# Check from the tacctl server: tacctl scope snmp lab test <device-address>   (expects sysName 'core-sw1')

Unfilled SNMP values: tacctl server address (pass --source <address>)
